videos.title: Why Your Relationship are Over Dramatic
videos.description: If your relationship swings between the highest highs and the lowest lows, it's not passion. It's an emotional addiction. Casino games are designed around a concept called intermittent reinforcement. It's basically promised rewards at unexpected times. The fact that you spin a slot machine and you never know when you're gonna win and when you're gonna lose, is the magic formula that keeps your brain hooked.
